colours.name: Sindoor Red
colours.use: Wordmark, section markers, live and breaking. Never more than 10% of a screen.

colours.name: Indigo Black
colours.use: Backgrounds and body text. Warmer and deeper than pure black.

colours.name: Haldi Gold
colours.use: Highlights on dark surfaces only. Fails contrast on light.

colours.name: Bone
colours.use: Light backgrounds. Reads warmer than white on a phone screen.

colours.name: Fresh Green
colours.use: Live indicators and positive change only. Never decorative.
